Name: Frogs to Turtles
Author: LadyEleven
Description:
This mod converts the frog/toad sprites into turtles. They still hop a bit and you will still hear frog sounds, but the sprites have been changed to turtles and Sebastian's dialogue which references frogs has been changed to reference turtles. Or at least, an attempt was made. I've never edited dialogue before, and couldn't really test it as well as I would like. If it's broken, let me know and I'll upload a sprite-only version until I can better test the dialogue edits.

The art assets come from NexusMods user [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3296607]HohenHeizen[/url] from their mod "Dinosaur Replacement - Turtle" at https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2778. According to the permissions on this page, they provide permission to use the assets as long as it is not monetized (and I will not be accepting donations for this mod). If they retract permission, I will take down this mod until I can find other sprites to use.
